summary: BTC ~$76.7k, -3.4% in 24h, heading for a second straight red October (high above $86k earlier in the month). ETF outflows and weak demand cited; Friday tech selloff (S&P -1.8%, Nasdaq -2.9%) and rumours of leveraged-fund liquidations weigh on risk. Aftermath of the 29 Oct Binance breach (~$6.3B) still in the news; Aave markets reopened. Fear & Greed ~30. Strategy (MSTR) to fund buys mainly via preferred stock (mild support).
catalyst_note: Binance security breach 29 Oct (~$6.3B stolen), exchange says it will cover losses
